title: Jazzy Moroccan Lemon Kebabs
description: Spicy, crunchy, and monsoon-inspired Moroccan dish featuring unwaxed lemons and a unique kneading technique, perfect for diabetic-friendly meals served on a hot stone plate.

ingredients.name: Kneaded Spicy Meat Mix
ingredients.notes: Use store-bought or homemade mix of lamb, beef, and spices.

ingredients.name: Bulghur Wheat
ingredients.notes: Use fine or medium grind bulghur.

instructions: Mix together chopped cilantro, crushed red pepper flakes, paprika, garlic powder, cumin powder, and garam masala in a small bowl.
In a large bowl, combine the kneaded spicy meat mix, bulghur wheat, salt, black pepper, and mixed spice blend. Mix well with your hands until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the meat mixture and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned and cooked through, about 8-10 minutes.
While the meat is cooking, prepare the hot stone plate by placing it under the broiler for 5-7 minutes, or until it reaches 500°F (260°C).
Transfer the cooked meat mixture to a serving vessel, and arrange the sliced unwaxed lemons on top.
Drizzle with remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil and sprinkle with chopped cilantro.
Serve immediately on the hot stone plate, garnished with a sprinkle of hot harissa, if using.
Repeat as desired for additional servings, ensuring to adjust cooking time and temperature as needed for a consistent result.
